policy.fallback_ladder: For blank rows: the captured HLTV probe is recorded as blocked (HTTP 403); external markets were checked; no originated/VRS estimate is published because the retained VRS snapshot is flagged stale or unverified for these fixtures.
policy.fixture_discovery: HotSpawn fixture/lobby records determine the listed open matches only.
policy.market_math: For each two-way quote, implied probabilities are normalized by their sum to remove the overround. Consensus weights: Pinnacle 2; Bovada 1; Melbet 1.
policy.probabilities: Each published probability is a weighted no-vig consensus of independently re-derived external bookmaker odds. HotSpawn crowd ownership is never read or used.
policy.standard_join: Both full normalized token sequences (case/diacritics/punctuation and generic organization suffix only) plus a source start within five minutes must match.
policy.token_reorder_exception: Only if both entire team-token multisets match exactly, opponent and verified source start match, and ordinary ordered matching failed. No aliases, prefixes, substrings, or fuzzy name matching are permitted.
policy.unresolved: A blank probability means no eligible external price passed the documented join checks; it is not a 50/50 estimate.
